models.thread: The hiring thread this ranking belongs to - one role being hired for one business.
models.phase: Phase 4, Ranking - the overall status of scoring and how many applicants have been processed so far.
models.summary: Headline counts for the leaderboard - total applicants, how many are scored, shortlisted, rejected, and the average score.
models.scoringCategories: The five priority-ranked criteria from Phase 3 that every applicant is scored against.
models.applicants: A candidate who applied for the role. Has a CV, an overall AI score, a per-category score breakdown, and a status.
models.applicantScore: One applicant's score against one Scoring Category - a 1-10 rating with a written explanation and a quoted CV snippet as evidence.

relationships: Each Applicant belongs to one Hiring Thread
Each Applicant has one Applicant Score per Scoring Category (five in total)
Each Applicant Score links to a Scoring Category via categoryPriority
The Summary counts are computed across all Applicants in the thread
Scoring Categories are carried over from Phase 3 (Role Outcomes)

scoringCategories.label: Independent Job Ownership
scoringCategories.description: Can run a residential or light commercial job from quote to completion without supervision.
scoringCategories.priorityReason: The role exists specifically to remove the ceiling created by only the owner being able to run jobs end to end.

scoringCategories.label: Licensing & Technical Depth
scoringCategories.description: Fully licensed with the years on the tools to handle renovations, hot water, and leak detection confidently.
scoringCategories.priorityReason: A non-negotiable baseline, but ranked below ownership because plenty of licensed plumbers still can't run a job.

scoringCategories.label: Customer Communication
scoringCategories.description: Can talk to customers properly, set expectations, and represent the business inside someone's home.
scoringCategories.priorityReason: Named as exactly what went wrong with the hire that didn't work out, and the business runs on word of mouth.

scoringCategories.label: Workmanship Standard
scoringCategories.description: Takes pride in clean, finished work that holds up and reflects the Patterson name.
scoringCategories.priorityReason: Central to the business's reputation, though it tends to come bundled with technical depth.

scoringCategories.label: Longevity & Fit
scoringCategories.description: Likely to stay and grow with the business rather than treating it as a stepping stone.
scoringCategories.priorityReason: The crew's long tenure shows this matters, but it's the hardest to read from a CV.

applicants.name: Darren Mitchell
applicants.cvText: Licensed plumber and gasfitter with 14 years' experience across residential renovation, hot water, and leak detection. Spent the last six years running my own north-side service business with a team of two, handling everything from first quote to final handover. Known for clean finishes and zero warranty callbacks. Now looking to bring that experience into an established team with room to lead. References available from long-term clients and trade partners.

applicants.name: Lachlan Reed
applicants.cvText: I finished my plumbing apprenticeship just over three years ago and got my licence about eighteen months back. Since then I've been working for a mid-sized residential outfit doing a real mix of work - bathroom renovations, hot water swaps, blocked drains, the lot. I've always had someone more senior on site with me but lately I've been getting handed smaller jobs to run on my own and it's gone well. I'm honestly really keen to find somewhere I can keep growing, get more renovation work under my belt, and stick around for the long haul rather than bouncing between sites. I think I'm good with customers - I always explain what I'm doing and why - and I take a lot of pride in leaving a job tidy. I know I'm not the most experienced person who'll apply for this but I'm hungry and I learn fast.
